svg.title: Package Diagram
svg.desc: Frontend inventory screens depend on shared HTTP, authentication and request-ID utilities. Backend routes use inventory services and models, including direct report/history queries; services use the persistence models.
svg.text: UML packages | inventory source organization and package dependencies
API handlers, reports and access checks
Stock rules and order stock integration
Packages map to actual source directories. Dashed dependencies point to the package used; the HTTP boundary is between applications.
